name: Gulf / US–Iran war
summary: Rubio sees no breakthrough with Iran; Trump calls new strikes highly unlikely if a deal is signed; US blockade continues
state: Secretary of State Rubio said on 8 Nov he would not describe the sides as on the verge of a breakthrough; President Trump said new strikes were highly unlikely if a strong agreement is signed, and Foreign Minister Araghchi repeated a two-day proposal to reopen Hormuz if US conditions are met (Al Jazeera). Centcom said it disabled the M/V Huda on 7 Nov as it tried to breach the blockade (Gulf News). A drone attack reported on 9 Nov on Iraq's Khor Mor gas field cut about 2.8 GW of generation, with no claim of responsibility (Gulf News). Attacks on shipping set the Alert.
for_you: Fuel and energy costs stay exposed to events in the Gulf. For travel in the region, check FCDO advice for each country, as airspace and advisories can change quickly.
rubric_hit: Attacks on Gulf shipping continuing: Centcom disabled M/V Huda on 7 Nov under the US blockade

sources.title: Al Jazeera — Rubio says war on Iran unpopular but necessary to stop nuclear threat

why: Direct hostilities between Iran and the US or Israel threaten Gulf energy infrastructure, the Strait of Hormuz and the wider region.
drivers: Strikes and retaliation, attacks on shipping and Gulf states, mediation and ceasefire talks, US force posture.

rubric.alert: Active strikes between states, attacks on Gulf energy infrastructure or shipping, or the Strait of Hormuz substantially closed.
rubric.watch: A ceasefire or stalemate with sporadic strikes, or credible threats of renewed strikes.
rubric.normal: No direct state-on-state hostilities; diplomacy active.
